items.3w1_d_0: What do you do on Monday?
items.3w1_d_3: Yes. I have a busy week.
items.3w1_copy: On Monday, I have music class. On Wednesday, I play with my team. Today I am busy, but I am happy. Tomorrow is a rest day at home.
items.3w2_d_3: Yes. I listen to music every day.
items.3w2_copy: My favorite hobby is drawing. I like drawing animals and places. My friend likes dancing. We share our hobbies after school.
items.3w3_d_1: It is next to the bank.
items.3w3_d_2: Is the station across the street?
items.3w3_d_3: Yes, it is near the hospital.
items.3w3_copy: Our town has a busy market. The bank is next to the market. The station is across the street. People walk safely around town.
items.3w4_d_1: He is reading a picture book.
items.3w4_copy: Look at the picture. A boy is walking by the river. Two girls are reading under a tree. Everyone is busy now.
items.3w5_d_1: I feel excited because it is my birthday.
items.3w5_d_3: He feels tired because he ran fast.
items.3w5_copy: I feel happy because my friend is here. My sister feels tired after the game. She rests because she needs a break. We talk about our feelings.
items.3w6_d_1: First, ask the teacher for help.
items.3w6_d_2: Then I will call my dad.
items.3w6_d_3: Finally, we find it under the chair!
items.3w6_copy: First, I lose my blue bag. Then I ask a teacher for help. We look under the desk together. Finally, I find my bag.
items.3w7_d_1: I can see dark clouds and a river.
items.3w7_copy: I can see clouds above the river. The wind is moving the trees. Rain is coming in this season. We watch the sky and stay safe.
items.3w8_d_3: Finally, I go home because I am tired.
items.3w8_copy: First, I eat breakfast in the morning. Then I learn and play at school. In the afternoon, I help my friend. Finally, I go home because I am tired.
